# Country scope. Ming 2.0 host check (reuses verified oe_pmng_is_host: non-rebel MNG or Han Middle Kingdom leader, excluding CHI/YUA/MCH).
oe_mg2_is_host = {
	oe_pmng_is_host = yes
}

# Country scope. True when Ming faces late-Ming fiscal, climatic, or insurgent distress.
oe_mg2_late_ming_distress = {
	OR = {
		is_situation_active = situation:little_ice_age
		has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_little_ice_age
		has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_silver_price_revolution
		stability < 12
		war_exhaustion >= 8
		is_during_bankruptcy = yes
		num_loans >= 5
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_mg2_uprising_intensity }
			var:oe_mg2_uprising_intensity >= 45
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
	}
}

# Country scope. True when Ming retains at least one core southern bastion.
oe_mg2_holds_south_bastion = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:shangyuan
		owns = location:minxian
		owns = location:jinjiang
		owns = location:guangzhou
		owns = location:panyu
		owns = location:gaoyao
		owns = location:lingui
		owns = location:kunming
		owns = location:hangzhou
	}
}

# Country scope. True when the northern capital Dadu has been lost.
oe_mg2_northern_capital_lost = {
	NOT = { owns = location:dadu }
}

# Country scope. True when Ming holds key northern wall/frontier anchors.
oe_mg2_great_wall_anchor = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:dadu
		owns = location:huailai
		owns = location:datong_datong
		owns = location:funing
	}
}

# Country scope. Clean exit trigger for oe_mg2_late_ming_uprising disaster.
oe_mg2_disaster_pacified = {
	is_during_bankruptcy = no
	stability >= 25
	OR = {
		current_year >= 1685
		has_country_modifier = oe_mg2_mod_uprising_pacified
		AND = {
			at_war = no
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = oe_mg2_mod_clean_censorate
				has_country_modifier = oe_mg2_mod_shaanxi_relief_granaries
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_mg2_uprising_intensity }
					var:oe_mg2_uprising_intensity <= 15
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}
